{{Top|leg}}
'''Voria Sergar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. She served as a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Karthakk system]].

==Biography==
Voria Sergar was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] at a young age when her [[Slaver/Legends|slave master]] abandoned her on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]]. She wandered the barren, dusty planet for several months, surviving many near-[[Death/Legends|death]] situations. When she was finally found by the Rebel officer [[Isnal Roran]], she was battered and bruised.

Sergar became a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on Lok and quickly ascended the Alliance's ranks. She proved to be a skillful [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], her abilities and fluidity with slicing and manipulating [[Computer/Legends|computers]] were considered great assets to the Rebellion. She also trained to be a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. and earned her wings.

She was killed in the [[Karthakk system]] when her ship was struck by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile/Legends|missile]]. It was said that each member of the Rebellion, no matter how far away, felt her passing. The fourth quadrant of the Karthakk system was named [[Voria's Ember]] in her honor.
